result.quote: the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath are to guard the house of the LORD for the king.
result.reason: The key is uniquely supported: the two divisions going off duty are assigned to guard the LORD’s house. However, “groups not serving” is potentially misleading because they are still given guard duty. Clearer wording would be: “What are the two divisions going off duty on the Sabbath to do?”
